method: Each pass reads this file, checks one slice of the spec, then raises, merges, or drops gaps.

gaps.title: Three different ready definitions
gaps.note: P31: one R1 list is now the fix. US1 and the micro brief are prose, not the gate.

gaps.title: Dirty tree includes the loop's own files
gaps.note: P51: unrelated dirty paths at loop start block. Paths the loop touched are expected and stay unstaged until commit.

gaps.title: build, test:quick, and wiring audit have no single job
gaps.note: P37: build runs before the coder returns. The checker runs test:quick, then the wiring audit as its own checklist. test:full runs at slice end.

gaps.title: force-pack leaves state.pack stale
gaps.note: P43: install writes pack, status idle, round_trips 0, and push. force-pack updates state.pack.

gaps.title: Nobody writes the retrospective completed=N line
gaps.note: P49: monotonic count from the log lines is enough. The retrospective reads commits since the last line.

gaps.title: Reviewer fail has no return path
gaps.note: P64: role fail with a question -> coordinator asks human -> same-role re-handoff as one round trip. needs-sign-off still pauses without a re-handoff.

gaps.title: 1-pack has no result.md writer
gaps.note: P34: the 1-pack coordinator appends its own check and review entries.

gaps.title: Next task and handoff fields are undefined
gaps.note: P35: handoff names feature, task, role, root, and the three spec paths. The task is the first open checkbox.

gaps.title: Finished loop asks for a pull request that may not exist
gaps.note: P39: the ending step asks for pull-request approval only when pr_url is set. A local-only finish asks for local merge approval.

gaps.title: One result.md cannot store both gates
gaps.note: P34: result.md is a list of role outcomes for the current task. A later pass appends. It does not overwrite.

gaps.title: No open tasks is both success and a blocked status
gaps.note: P32: exit 0 status complete when every box is checked and R1 inputs exist. Exit 2 stays for missing inputs or trunk.

gaps.title: Empty commands.json is sticky and initial state has no schema
gaps.note: P44: reinstall fills only empty command strings. It never clears a value.

gaps.title: Hive command defaults use OR in the spec and AND in the plan
gaps.note: P33: per-command evidence. test:quick only from pytest evidence. test:full only from ci-check. No cross-fill.

gaps.title: 1-pack install file set is ambiguous
gaps.note: P43: 1-pack writes coordinator.md only, plus retrospective, NOTICE, commands, state, and log.

gaps.title: No Cursor entry point for a role pass
gaps.note: P36: the always-on rule only points at the command, matching bug hunt. The command starts each 4-pack role as its own subagent.

gaps.title: test:full failure has no recovery
gaps.note: P40: a test:full failure sets status blocked, keeps the commits, and adds no task.

gaps.title: Home does not say what a second enable does
gaps.note: P42: Home on the same pack refreshes prompts. A different pack asks for force. Cancel writes nothing.

gaps.title: Chat text does not define how a feature id is chosen
gaps.note: P42: a feature id in the message wins. Else the only spec with an open box. Else ask.

gaps.title: state.json holds one feature and a second start is undefined
gaps.note: P42: a running feature asks before state.feature changes.

gaps.title: Commit path list is undefined
gaps.note: P38: the commit is the task's product files, tasks.md, and an approved plan.md edit. Loop runtime files stay unstaged.

gaps.title: Assumption text has no format
gaps.note: P35: assumption is a marked line. R6 pauses only on an unresolved mark.

gaps.title: A behavior stop does not set state
gaps.note: P45: on a behavior stop, status is blocked, the diff stays uncommitted, and the box is not checked.

gaps.title: Retrospective has no path when propose rejects a bullet
gaps.note: P41: a rejected behavioral bullet stays in the proposal file under its feature id. The human picks the spec to edit.

gaps.title: implement the spec is a broad start phrase
gaps.note: P47: the phrase is fine. R8 already excludes a question, and the command asks which feature when the target is unclear. The agent's own words do not re-enter because the rule is user-scoped by the installed command's read step.

gaps.title: Macro names a loop the CLI does not install yet
gaps.note: P11: the impact packet already records this. It is a draft-spec risk, not a behavior hole.

gaps.title: Support star checkboxes
gaps.note: P27: Hive tasks use '- [ ]'. A second marker is a new format, not a hole in this spec.

gaps.title: No task ids in some Hive tasks files
gaps.note: P53: the handoff uses the task id when present, else the task line text and its section heading. Same rule for the commit message.

gaps.title: Result list has no task boundary
gaps.note: P55: the coordinator replaces result.md when the next task's handoff is written. Commit reads only entries for the current task.

gaps.title: Round-trip cap and re-handoff order
gaps.note: P67: the cap check runs before every delegation, including a re-handoff after a human answer.

gaps.title: Result list entry schema
gaps.note: P69: each result entry has task, role, outcome, evidence, and an optional question on fail.

gaps.title: Retrospective log header
gaps.note: P71: install writes one header comment. The count uses lines that match the date pattern.

gaps.title: Slice heading rule when tasks.md has no ## sections
gaps.note: P73: a slice is the first ## section that contains a checkbox. If none exists, the whole file is one slice.

gaps.title: Commit message when a task has no id
gaps.note: P75: the commit message uses the task id when present, else a 6-10 word slug from the task text.

gaps.title: Push failure handling
gaps.note: P77: a push failure keeps the commit, sets status blocked, and asks the human. It does not retry silently.

gaps.title: Home install and branch state
gaps.note: P79: install is allowed on trunk. Readiness blocks until a non-trunk branch exists.

gaps.title: No spec for the result list reset on a new feature
gaps.note: P81: a new feature starts with an empty result.md. The coordinator clears it when the feature's first handoff is written.

learned_fixes: One ready list: project.json, spec, plan, tasks, micro brief, one open task, non-empty build and test:quick and test:full, pack, non-trunk branch.
All boxes checked and the other inputs present is status complete, exit 0.
result.md stores one outcome per role for the current task.
Reviewer fail returns to the coder. needs-sign-off waits for the human.
1-pack writes only the coordinator role file and still appends check and review outcomes.
Handoff names feature, task, role, root, and the three spec paths. The task is the first open checkbox.
Loop files under .hive/implementation-loop/ are expected dirt and stay unstaged.
test:full failure blocks, keeps commits, and adds no task.
The coordinator appends the retrospective line when a feature completes.
The command starts each 4-pack role as its own subagent. The always-on rule only points at the command.
spec_patch_order_r3: plan.md result schema and push failure
clarification_flow: role fail with question -> coordinator asks human -> re-handoff to same role as one round trip
result_entry_schema: task, role, outcome, evidence, question (fail only)
push_failure: keep commit, set blocked, ask human, no silent retry
